description: This file defines API endpoints related to matches and events for a sports live stream platform using FastAPI. It includes route handlers for retrieving match lists, live matches, match details, highlights, upcoming matches, as well as event lists, event details, and event matches. The endpoints support filtering, pagination, and optional authentication.

classes.name: Match
classes.description: Data model representing a sports match, including teams, score, status, start time, etc.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Data model representing a sports event or tournament, including name, sport type, start/end dates, featured status.

classes.name: MatchListResponse
classes.description: Response model for returning a list of matches with pagination info.

classes.name: EventListResponse
classes.description: Response model for returning a list of events with pagination info.

classes.name: HighlightListResponse
classes.description: Response model for returning match highlights with pagination data.

classes.name: MatchStatus
classes.description: Enum representing possible statuses of a match (e.g., scheduled, live, finished).

classes.name: SportType
classes.description: Enum representing different types of sports (e.g., football, basketball).

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents a sports event or tournament, including its details.

methods.description: Fetches a list of matches with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: get_events( page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), sport: Optional[SportType] = Query(None, description="Filter by sport type"), featured: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter featured events"), user_id: Optional[str] = Depends(optional_auth) )

methods.description: Fetches matches associated with a specific event, with filtering and pagination.
